name: hello
description: The example plugin: greets, sends a message to a thread through the host, keeps a word in the Keychain, follows the thread list, flags threads and gives new threads CF_HELLO=1.

commands.name: send
commands.title: Send Hello to Thread
commands.description: Send a message to a thread through Code Foundry (thread.send).

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread (default: the active one, or --context-thread)

commands.name: remember
commands.title: Remember a Word
commands.description: Keep a word in the Keychain, in the plugin's own namespace.

commands.name: forget
commands.title: Forget the Word
commands.description: Remove the remembered word from the Keychain.

commands.name: unpin
commands.title: Unpin Hello
commands.description: Withdraw the pinned surface from a thread (the demo's Pin button adds it).

commands.name: flag
commands.title: Flag Thread
commands.description: Raise (or with level none clear) the plugin's flag on a thread: the thread needs attention in the sidebar.

args.name: until-seen
args.description: Clear it when the thread is opened

args.name: thread
args.description: The thread (default: the active one, or --context-thread)

commands.name: events
commands.title: Count Thread Events
commands.description: Say how many thread list events the plugin received since it started.
